author: abcoathup
content:
**Client teams, it would be very helpful if you were to use the same scale for non-headliner EIP prioritization.**
This would allow quick (or even automated) summarising of all teams priorities ready for shortlisting.  Especially if you use the excellent Forkcast ranking.

*Please note, you can share your priorities however you like, using whatever scale you like.  Sharing using Forkcast, via URL and the same scale would just make the process of getting to shortlisting faster & easier.*

Ethlabs used the following scale: (easier to follow their lead as they were one of the first to share)

[S-tier] strongly recommend inclusion
[A-tier] recommend inclusion if blockers are cleared (e.g., complexity assessment, impact analysis, path to adoption)
[B-tier] stretch goal
[D-tier] recommend rejection
[forming opinion] no opinion yet (EIPs left unranked)

https://forkcast.org/rank/
